title: The Form Series
bodyHtml:
Subtle Sophistication

Presenting the Form Basin Series — beautifully hand crafted Italian design pieces that strike the perfect balance between understated elegance and functional design.

Beautiful and Versatile

Form is effortlessly elegant — It’s finely crafted walls blend seamlessly into the basin’s interior, guiding water gracefully into the centred waste.

Form comes in a rich palette of tactile matte and gloss colours, from timeless matte white, to ultra-modern gloss myrtle, for those who really want to make a statement.

Available in Circular, Rectangular and Oval variations, Form is a celebration of simple geometry, and is home in both soft square and more organic styles of bathroom aesthetic.

Perfect with the Lust Bath

Form is the perfect complement to our Lust Bath, known for its sumptuous curves and sleek, floating design. Together, they create a harmonious look that elevates any bathroom project.

A Seamless Design Solution

Bring the whole aesthetic together with our Milady Toilet Series. Continuing the floating, minimalist theme throughout, Milady adds the finishing touch to a complete design solution across your bathroom.
